LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrix.label: brood matrix
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrix.description: A brood organ that grows up to four children eighty times faster, feeding on hemogel until they turn thirteen. A living donor sealed in its core ages away as its skills, passions, traits and genes are shared out among the children, and without a donor the children stop growing. Only outsiders can serve as donors, never pawns accepted by the flesh colony or grown in the flesh. Starved capsules kill their occupants.
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixEmbryo.label: brood matrix embryo
LanguageData.FB_BroodMatrixEmbryo.description: An immature brood organ that will grow into a brood matrix.
